assessment: The YamunaNagar District Revenue Office maintains district Jamabandi land records and consolidation “Mussavies” maps; it reports district Jamabandis computerized. officialPrimarySources.observation: Official YamunaNagar District Revenue page says the Sadar Kanungo Branch maintains land ownership/cultivation records, district Jamabandis and Mussavies; it reports all district Jamabandis computerized.
Official district e-governance directory links Web-HALRIS at jamabandi.nic.in.
Official Haryana IT department describes Web-HALRIS as an integrated deed-registration and land-records system implemented in all tehsils.
Government of India DILRMP page identifies Haryana, district Yamunanagar in map digitization/geo-reference reporting; the page did not expose usable parcel layer/API metadata.
